hero.description: I'm Mohamed Marzouq — a software engineer helping Arab developers level up through code, coaching and content. From cracking interviews to shipping real products.

about.label: About
about.description1: I'm Mohamed Marzouq — a software engineer with a deep love for clean code and craft. I build products, mentor engineers and create Arabic tech content that makes complex engineering accessible.
about.description2: Through coaching, tutorials and honest conversations about the tech industry, I help developers across the Arab world land jobs at top companies and navigate their careers with confidence.

work.label: What I Do
work.fullStackDesc: Building production-grade apps with React, Node.js, TypeScript, and modern cloud infrastructure.
work.systemDesignDesc: Designing scalable architectures, distributed systems, and clean APIs that grow with the product.
work.aiDesc: Shipping intelligent features — from LLM-powered workflows to practical developer tooling.
work.mentorshipDesc: Coaching engineers one-on-one on interviews, career growth, and navigating the tech industry.

videos.label: Videos
videos.title: Content for the Arab tech community.
videos.description: From DSA deep-dives to career advice and honest opinions — all in Arabic.

contact.description: Whether you want coaching, have a collaboration in mind, or just want to say hello — reach out anytime.
